text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Jingle, jingle, jingle, jingle...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I wanna go somewhere special
today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, it is the holidays, so there's
only one
place that fits the bill...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And that's a rural fishing village!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I expected somewhere more fancy, but I
was
completely off the mark. Several bus
rides later,
we arrive at a snowy fishing
village.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our footsteps crunch with each step
through the
snow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bwooom...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is it! This is the atmosphere I was
hoping for!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The snow blowing against the window,
the faintly
visible fishing port in the
distance, and the barely
audible sound
of a steam whistle...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've been transported right
into the
world of enka music. It's so
awesome...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Melancholic? Well, I'd probably feel
that way if
nobody else was here...
choice_data_list_en: Doesn't it feel a bit lonely?
Don't you feel a little lonely?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But I feel fine because you're here with
me!
Besides, if I had free rein over how I
celebrated
the holidays, I'd do it in
peace and tranquility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering how boisterous Kitasan
Black usually
is, I'm surprised by how
austere her preferences
are.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, do you want anything to
drink,
Trainer? I can pour it for you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What should I have? Hmm... I think I've
have a
warm glass of cider...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I prefer to drink it warm rather
than cold.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
There's just something so good about
warm apple
cider. It just goes down so
smooth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a moment of shock, I realize she's
talking
about non-alcoholic cider.
What's more, she has
quite a
sophisticated way of drinking it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel like having cake today. I
think I'm in
the mood for some
soy-pickled squid or fish
cakes with
wasabi!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, Happy Holidays, Trainer! Let's
take it
easy today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We toast each other while gazing at the
falling
snow. It turns out to be a
strangely charming time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We knock back drink after drink while
reminiscing
on times since passed.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Spending time like this is so nice... This
might
really be enough for us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Well, I feel like we normally live in
excess, or
like... There's just so many
things around us all the
time.
choice_data_list_en: What do you mean, 'this is plenty'?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But if you whittle everything down to
the bare
necessities...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You'll discover all we really need in life
is some
food and drink with a close
friend, and the
occasional toot of a
distant steam whistle...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's what I mean by this being enough.
I could
live happily with just what we
have here.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I feel so moved... I've always wanted to
visit a
place like this at least once in my
life.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for accompanying
me here,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black looks totally relaxed as
she enjoys
the holidays in a simple yet
reflective manner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I feel lucky to see a side of
the clutch
captain Kitasan Black that no
one else has ever
seen before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I feel lucky to see a side of
the clutch
captain Kitasan Black that no
one else has ever
seen before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Old Fisherman
text_block_list.text: Kita... Are you there, Kita?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? You're one of the local
fishermen... Is
everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Old Fisherman
text_block_list.text:
We prepared a festive li'l tree for ya.
Care to take
a look?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A tree?! For me? What do you think,
Trainer?
Should we go?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The news that none other than the Kitasan Black is visiting this village is bound to be a big deal.
choice_data_list: ああ、歓迎されてるみたいだな
ああ、歓迎されてるみたいだね
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, looks like we're being welcomed.
Yeah, seems like they're welcoming us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's go check it out, then! We
can't walk
away from such a kind offer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The old man takes Kitasan Black by the
arm and
leads us to a mountain path that
lies beyond the
village. We follow it
until...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoooa, check out this tree!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're greeted by the stunning sight of a

magnificent fir tree reaching towards the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Old Fisherman
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any ornaments for it, but I
did my
best to sweep some of the snow
off and make it
look prettier.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is more than enough for me! Nature
on its
own is plenty beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is the ultimate gift, don't you think,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sure! Let's do it together!
choice_data_list_en: Yeah... Want to make a wish?
Yeah... Want to make a wish?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a big smile on her face, Kitasan
Black clasps
her hands together and
makes a wish.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We promise to live our lives with dignity,
just like
this great tree.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if we're nothing to look at, we'll
stand true
and tall, and penetrate
through any thick snow
clouds that get
in our way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The great fir tree and snowy sky above
appear to
fully accept Kitasan Black's
earnest wish.
